paragraphs.text: Many employees now work from home for at least part of the week. For some, the freedom is welcome, but others find that the boundary between work and personal life quickly disappears.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The most common piece of advice is to create a separate working area. Even a small table in a quiet corner helps the brain to connect that space with work, and makes it easier to stop at the end of the day.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: A regular routine is equally important. People who start and finish at the same times each day, and take proper breaks, report feeling less tired than those who work whenever they have a free moment.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Isolation is a problem that many home workers do not expect. Without casual conversations in the kitchen or corridor, people can feel cut off from their team. Short video calls that are not about work can help.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Finally, home workers should check that their equipment is safe and comfortable. A chair that supports the back and a screen at eye level can prevent pain that often develops after months of working on a sofa.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: For some, the freedom is welcome, but others find that the boundary between work and personal life quickly disappears

explanation.en: Some welcome the freedom, others struggle: “For some, the freedom is welcome, but others …” → iii “Mixed feelings”. Saving on travel (vi) is never mentioned.
explanation.kk: Біреулерге еркіндік ұнайды, біреулерге кедергі: «For some, the freedom is welcome, but others …» → iii «Mixed feelings». Жол шығынын үнемдеу (vi) туралы сөз жоқ.
explanation.ru: Одним свобода нравится, другим мешает: «For some, the freedom is welcome, but others …» → iii «Mixed feelings». Об экономии на дороге (vi) нет ни слова.

items.quote: The most common piece of advice is to create a separate working area

explanation.en: “create a separate working area” — a place just for work → i “Having a dedicated place to work”.
explanation.kk: «create a separate working area» — жұмысқа арналған бөлек орын → i «Having a dedicated place to work».
explanation.ru: «create a separate working area» — отдельное место для работы → i «Having a dedicated place to work».

items.quote: People who start and finish at the same times each day

explanation.en: A regular routine: starting and finishing “at the same times each day” → v “The value of fixed hours”.
explanation.kk: Тұрақты күн тәртібі: жұмысты «at the same times each day» бастап, аяқтау → v «The value of fixed hours».
explanation.ru: Регулярный распорядок: начинать и заканчивать «at the same times each day» → v «The value of fixed hours».

items.quote: Short video calls that are not about work can help

explanation.en: The problem of isolation and the fix — short video calls with the team → ii. Heading vii catches “video calls”, but nothing about choosing a provider.
explanation.kk: Оқшаулану мәселесі және шешімі — командамен қысқа бейнеқоңырау → ii. vii тақырыбы «video calls» тіркесіне ілінеді, бірақ провайдер таңдау туралы ештеңе жоқ.
explanation.ru: Проблема одиночества и решение — короткие видеозвонки с командой → ii. Заголовок vii ловит «video calls», но о выборе провайдера ничего нет.

items.quote: A chair that supports the back and a screen at eye level can prevent pain

explanation.en: A supportive chair and a screen at eye level “can prevent pain” → iv “Looking after your body”.
explanation.kk: Ыңғайлы орындық пен көз деңгейіндегі экран «can prevent pain» → iv «Looking after your body».
explanation.ru: Удобный стул и экран на уровне глаз «can prevent pain» → iv «Looking after your body».

Mixed feelings about a new way of working

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. The text has five paragraphs, A–E. Choose the correct heading for each paragraph from the list of headings below. Write the correct number, i–vii.
